function.name: show_choices
function.description: Display exactly one multiple-choice English activity and wait for the student to choose. You must use this tool when the student asks for an interactive question, multiple-choice question, quiz, or selectable choices.

question.description: A short English question shown to the student.

choices.description: Two to four short, unique answer choices.

correct_answer.description: The exact text of one item in choices.
